reviews.title: This stuff is the real deal - IT WORKS!!
reviews.body:
I have a 3-year old Silver Lab who has had skin/fur issues on and off for the past few years.  I purchased this product after reading a previous review (a few reviews down) of another silver lab that this product worked for.  Silver labs are a diluted color breed that are notorious for skin/coat issues.  Oliver has had issues with thinning coat, itchiness, and patchiness that come in waves as the seasons change - nothing that has affected his health, but annoyances that both he and I (and other people) notice.  He was tested for a thyroid issue and those tests came back normal.  I've tried everything the vet has recommended - switching to a salmon-based food, allergy shots, allergy tablets, fish oil pills, medicated shampoo, conditioner, etc and nothing has really treated the problem completely. The veterinarian finally said that it was just how he is and something I'd have to live with. I finally decided to try this when he lost an old-man style patch on the top of his head.
I did the 8 week recommended program with Dermoscent and it really is a miracle.  I don't usually write reviews online but if your dog is struggling with any skin/coat issues, you need to give this a try.  All of the problems you see in the pictures are gone.  No more spotting, no more hair loss, no more itching, and on top of that, his coat has thickened significantly and is very shiny.  It looks HEALTHY.  The hair on the top of his head filled in as well, which is something I was worried would never come back. This product also has a pleasing scent and is easy to apply (just once a week for 8 weeks).
Now that the 8 weeks is over I'll be watching for any issues and if they do happen I will be sure to buy it again.  This is the only thing I've tried that really works and does exactly what's promised.
THANK YOU for a great product and a happy dog & owner.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 10 de septiembre de 2020
